'''Wayyl''' was a [[planet]]<ref name="CGttSWG">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref> that was aligned with the [[Galactic Republic]] and was represented in the [[Galactic Senate]] [[Standard decade|decades]] prior to [[32 BBY]]. During that [[time]], it was represented in the Senate by [[Senator]] [[Dagonet]], one of the longest-standing senators of the Republic. The world was the site of a [[Mission to rescue Dagonet's son|mission]] where [[Jedi Master]] [[Dooku]] and his [[Padawan]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn]] were tasked with retrieving Dagonet's kidnapped [[Uriel Dagonet|son]].<ref name="Justice" />

Wayyl's surface, appearing [[Color|gray]] and dark green from [[orbit]], featured large open fields of grayish dirt and [[tree]]s, with little other [[Plant|vegetation]]. The planet also had a large [[ocean]] and many massive [[Water|lakes]] and rivers.<ref name="Justice" />
